phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before this timing record was created.

phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before this timing record was created.

phases.bottleneck_notes: Selected standard mode, identified agent-platform ownership, and separated deep research report readiness from existing research insight planning.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Created requirement, plan, traceability, research insight input, coding research input, and reusable research notes before implementation.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added deep-research readiness code, CLI, configs, docs, workflow, prompt, memory links, and initial tests.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran deep research tests, complete-deep-research sample, config contracts, memory bootstrap, maps, task board, timing check, agent listing, workspace health, and Workspace Monitor build.

phases.bottleneck_notes: Prepared grounding, work evaluation, request trace, work summary, and close-out records.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: Among measured completed phases before commit/push, implementation took the longest because it added Python readiness logic, CLI wiring, configs, docs, workflow, prompt, memory anchors, and tests in one pass.
improvement_candidates: If deep research setup repeatedly spends most time in documentation, consider a template generator for agent readiness specs.
If verification dominates, consider a grouped test command for agent-platform config and planning checks.
